records.subject: Academic Calendar and Registration Guidelines for Masters' Programmes
records.content: All M.Tech. students are hereby informed that the academic session and registration for the upcoming semester must strictly follow the Academic Calendar as regulated by the Office of the Dean (Academic). Students must ensure that their semester load requirements are fulfilled during the designated registration period.

Students must ensure that their semester load requirements are fulfilled during the designated registration period.

records.subject: Strict Prohibition of Late Registration
records.content: It is brought to the notice of all Masters' students that no registration shall be allowed after the notified last date of registration during the semester except in special cases with the permission of the Dean (Academic) / Chairperson, Senate.
records.text: circular_id: MNNIT/AII/CSED/2022/02 | file_number: CSED/DMPC/OO/2022/04 | issue_date: 2022-08-10 | subject: Strict Prohibition of Late Registration | applicable_clauses: 4.1 | content: It is brought to the notice of all Masters' students that no registration shall be allowed after the notified last date of registration during the semester except in special cases with the permission of the Dean (Academic) / Chairperson, Senate.

records.subject: Guidelines on Semester Leave and Medical Leave
records.content: Students seeking leave exceeding permissible limits must note that semester leave up to a maximum of two semesters may be sanctioned for valid reasons. For serious medical conditions, medical leave of a maximum of 15 days in an academic year may be granted when endorsed by the institute medical officer or recognized hospitals.
records.text: circular_id: MNNIT/AII/CSED/2022/03 | file_number: CSED/DMPC/CIR/2022/09 | issue_date: 2022-09-05 | subject: Guidelines on Semester Leave and Medical Leave | applicable_clauses: 5.2, 5.3 | content: Students seeking leave exceeding permissible limits must note that semester leave up to a maximum of two semesters may be sanctioned for valid reasons. For serious medical conditions, medical leave of a maximum of 15 days in an academic year may be granted when endorsed by the institute medical officer or recognized hospitals.

records.subject: Supervisor Allocation and Academic Advising for Thesis Registration
records.content: All postgraduate students registering for thesis credits are hereby informed that they must have a thesis supervisor assigned to them. Students shall be advised in the selection of courses and research direction by the DMPC of the department.

Students shall be advised in the selection of courses and research direction by the DMPC of the department.

records.subject: Notice for DMPC Meeting on Thesis Submission Deadlines and Extensions
records.content: Notice is hereby given that a DMPC meeting is scheduled to evaluate thesis submission timelines, minimum residence periods, maximum durations, and requests for programme extensions as per academic ordinances.

records.subject: Stipend and Fellowship Release Protocols
records.content: The release of monthly stipends for Full-Time Non-Stipendiary and Full-Time Sponsored students is contingent upon maintaining satisfactory academic performance and meeting the mandatory attendance records stipulated by the institute.

records.subject: Mandatory Plagiarism and Similarity Checks Prior to Thesis Defense
records.content: In compliance with degree requirements, all graduating Masters' students must defend their final thesis and clear the mandatory plagiarism verification report through DMPC before final submission to the Examination Board.

records.subject: Procedure for Waiver of Course Requirements and Part-Time Admissions
records.content: Part-time admissions processed via DMSC must adhere to screening criteria based on experience and employment records. Any procedural waivers must follow the official channels established by the Office of the Dean (Academic).

Any procedural waivers must follow the official channels established by the Office of the Dean (Academic).

records.subject: Transcript Generation and Withholding of Grade Reports
records.content: Students are informed that grade reports and comprehensive transcripts containing grades for courses, thesis, and semester leaves are issued terminally. Grade reports will be withheld if students have pending institutional dues or disciplinary cases.

Grade reports will be withheld if students have pending institutional dues or disciplinary cases.

records.subject: Implementation of Academic Ordinances and Cancellation of Admission
records.content: Pursuant to decisions of the Senate, SMPC, and BoAc, the Office of the Dean (Academic) maintains records of admissions and terminations. The Dean (Academic), with the approval of the Senate, may cancel admission or withdraw degrees under rules governing academic indiscipline and ordinance violations.
